model: For each charge q, formation energy is E0(q)+q*EF in eV per defect. All chemical-potential references, charge corrections and host/cell conventions are already common and included in E0. EF is measured from the SAME valence-band maximum; the upper window endpoint is the stipulated band gap. Compare only the supplied charge states under the dilute noninteracting single-defect model.
reporting: Stable means attaining the GLOBAL minimum formation energy among every supplied charge. Return all INTERIOR lower-envelope transition Fermi energies in ascending order, not every pairwise intersection. A state never stable means it attains no minimum even at a transition or endpoint. Query charges follow original query order. Define U_for_q_plus1=E0(+2)+E0(0)-2*E0(+1); its sign tests whether the intermediate+1state can be skipped. Use1e-9eVcomparison tolerance. No charged defect concentration or kinetics is requested.

provenance.data_origin: Explicit benchmark-constructed model data. Energies and response tensors are conditional illustrative inputs, not claimed first-principles calculations or experimental properties of a named material.
